repairs.quote: Zaahen slashes twice on his next Attack, dealing (15/30/45/60/75 + (20/25/30/35/40% bonus Attack Damage)) bonus physical damage and restoring 5/6/7/8/9% of his max Health. Recast: Zaahen's next Attack deals (30/60/90/120/150 + (20/25/30/35/40% bonus Attack Damage)) bonus physical damage and Knocks the target Up for 0.75 seconds. Healing reduced to 50% against non-champions. Deals an additional 100% bonus damage to monsters.
